text:
sam (acct exec): Heads-up: GlimmerPay wants a 2-week trial to replace EchoAI. Main asks: prompt+function parity for structured JSON, webhook signature compatibility, EU-only processing, and a clear cost delta for their high-throughput auth path. Can we scope quickly?
leah (solutions): Quick q: do they rely on streaming for UX or mostly synchronous function calls for critical paths? Also what peak RPS?
sam (acct exec): UX uses streaming chat, but settlement is sync function-calls. Peak auth is ~250rps, average 60rps. They also use signed webhooks with X-ECHO-SIG.
pablo (engineer): Noted. EchoAI uses fixed 512-byte chunking for streams; our adaptive coalescing will change boundary events. We can ship a tiny proxy that emits Echo-like chunk framing and preserves chunk_id header so their client logic doesn't change.
anya (security): Security checklist: KMS/HSM, SOC2 docs, VPC peering for Private, and mutual TLS for webhook ingest. Also they need audit log export to their Splunk and EU-only data processing. I'll need their DPO and existing EchoAI security responses.
leah (solutions): Ask them to provide: 1) 10 sanitized prompts/function calls, 2) example webhook payloads, 3) validation schemas they run downstream. With that we can run side-by-side tests and produce a short delta report (token delta, schema pass rate, 3 failing examples).
sam (acct exec): I'll request artifacts and legal contact tonight.
pablo (engineer): Minimal smoke command for them to run client-side so we can get exact parity inputs:
```
# run against Redwood compat endpoint
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"rwd-echo-compat","prompt":"<<sanitized prompt>>","max_tokens":180,"stream":false}'
```
Then run the same prompt against EchoAI and paste outputs. We'll token-diff and JSON-validate.
leah (solutions): Pricing ask: prepare a two-column comparison: hosted per-token estimate vs Dedicated reserved pool with throughput pricing. Include a projected monthly bill for current traffic and a recommended POC credit. I think 30% POC credit is reasonable.
anya (security): Potential blocker: GlimmerPay insists on HSM-wrapped keys (customer-controlled) and mutual TLS with client certs for webhook endpoints. Confirm Dedicated + KMS bridge supports customer-managed key wrapping.
pablo (engineer): Other potential parity issues: EchoAI's tokenizer splits emojis as single tokens; our tokenizer may differ. We'll include a token-estimate script they can run locally and a small table of expected deltas for their 10 prompts. If sampling causes variance, we'll recommend deterministic params (temp=0, top_p=1) for auth flows.
contracts-bot: NDA template and SOC2 link posted when legal contact provided. Can push a one-way NDA <24h.
sam (acct exec): Timeline: if they share artifacts by EOD tomorrow, we can produce the POC bundle in 3 business days: shim + sample proxy, token-delta table, config mappings, pricing estimate, and security docs. Dedicated EU provisioning if requested will add ~4 business days.
leah (solutions): For webhook compatibility we will: 1) accept X-ECHO-SIG in the proxy and verify HMAC, 2) re-sign as X-RWD-SIG for internal flows, 3) optionally preserve original headers for their downstream. Small Node/Python snippets will be included.
pablo (engineer): I'll prepare a tiny reframe shim: normalize trailing commas in JSON, coerce number types when their validators are strict, and rewrap stream patches into choices[] arrays if they validate that shape.
anya (security): Add me to their security thread once NDA is signed. Also ask them for any ASN/IP egress denylists and whether they require FIPS-validated crypto.
sam (acct exec): Sounds good. I'll collect contacts and artifacts tonight.
leah (solutions): Once prompts arrive I'll run a 1-2 hour side-by-side and post a short exec summary: token delta, schema pass rate, any hallucination/regression flags.
pablo (engineer): If we see deterministic deltas tied to prompt-engine formatting, we can propose prompt-transforms instead of code changes. That keeps integration light.
sam (acct exec): I'll tell GlimmerPay: 1) we can do the 2-week POC, 2) need sanitized prompts & webhooks + legal/security contacts, 3) expect the POC pack in 3 business days after artifacts, 4) Dedicated EU adds ~4 days, 5) we propose a 30% POC credit to cover runbook/ops time.
leah (solutions): lgtm.
anya (security): lgtm, will prep questionnaire.
contracts-bot: Ready to issue NDA once legal contact provided.
